source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Thunderbird jar overrides the global infobar resource with its shared skin stylesheet. This landing resets the icon-container border, radius, background and padding, and removes an explicit button-part text color. Accepted source later adds a margin reset and narrows the button selector to the close control. Keep those phases separate and assess actual cascade/receiver markup before generalizing the reset. No resolved color, contrast, geometry or live accessibility result was measured.
title: The infobar icon reset belongs to the Thunderbird chrome override and its current selector phase
